preDelivery.title: 5 Key Checks Before Operating the Engine
preDelivery.intro: Complete these five checks before handing the engine over to a customer or starting it for the first time.

points.title: 1. Air filter
points.desc: Filters dust from the intake air to protect internal parts from wear.
steps: Fill engine oil into the filter pot.
Fill to the level mark shown on the pot.
Fit the air filter carefully so the rubber seal doesn't tear.
Add a little oil on top of the filter to help trap dust.

image.alt: Adding oil to the real air filter on a ZT Plus engine

points.title: 2. Fuel system
points.desc: Fuel mixes with air and ignites from compression heat to run the engine.
steps: Use clean fuel; no need to remove the filter while refuelling.
Check for leaks around the filter — no water or debris should be mixed into the fuel.

image.alt: The real fuel filter cup on a ZT Plus engine

points.title: 3. Engine oil
points.desc: Lubrication prevents wear, keeps moving parts free, and helps cool the engine.
steps: Use TRA CHANG engine oil, SAE40.
Add about 2.7-2.8 litres.
Oil level must sit between the upper and lower marks.
Before use, idle the engine 15-20 minutes to circulate oil fully.
Check the oil-pressure indicator — blue covering red means the lubrication system is working normally.

image.alt: The oil-pressure indicator (blue/red) on a real engine

points.title: 4. Cooling water system
steps: Add rust-proofing powder.
Fill with clean water.
Never use groundwater or canal water — it causes radiator sediment and clogging.

image.alt: Filling clean water into a real engine's radiator

points.title: 5. Fan belt
points.desc: Drives the cooling fan and other components.
steps: Press the middle of the belt with your finger to check tension.
Correct deflection is 10-15 mm.
If too tight or too loose, adjust to that range.

image.alt: Measuring fan belt deflection with a ruler

startProcedure.title: How to Start the KUBOTA Diesel Engine Correctly
steps: Move the accelerator to the starting position.
Attach the hand crank to the engine's starter shaft.
Turn the crank clockwise until it feels tight.
If the crank handle ends up on top, remove it.
Refit the crank onto the starter shaft with the handle at the bottom.
Lift the decompression (valve) lever and spin the crank 3-5 turns.
Release the valve lever and keep spinning — the engine will start.
caution: Hold the crank firmly after the engine starts so it doesn't fly out and cause injury — it will free itself and detach on its own.
Don't release the valve lever and stop cranking mid-way — this can cause the engine to kick back (smoke from the air filter) and spin in reverse.
If the engine kicks back, remove the air filter and check it — clean off any soot, or replace the filter if it's damaged.

assembly.title: How to Assemble the Diesel Engine with the Power Tiller
assembly.intro: Steps for assembling the TRA CHANG power tiller and attaching the KUBOTA diesel engine to it.
assembly.engineTitle: Attaching the Engine to the Power Tiller
tillerSteps: Assemble the hitch — it must sit on the left side of the power tiller.
Fit the wheels to the wheel axle — wheel blades must point toward the back of the power tiller.
engineSteps: Assemble the engine onto the power tiller chassis and tighten the engine mounting nuts.
Attach the pulley to the flywheel.
Attach the belt to the pulleys on both the power tiller and the engine.
Pull the engine forward to keep the belt tight, then tighten the nut; remove the engine stand.
Adjust belt tension to about 22-28 mm by tightening or loosening the nut.
Loosen the 2 nuts at the accelerator so the lever moves freely, then re-tighten.
Attach the accelerator cable to the accelerator lever and tighten the nut.

maintenance.title: Periodic Maintenance
maintenance.intro: Routine maintenance points for the ZT Plus diesel engine and the TRA CHANG power tiller, straight from the official maintenance training decks.

engine.title: ZT Plus Diesel Engine — 5 Key Maintenance Points

points.title: 1. Air filter
points.desc: Clean the pot and air filter element every 100 hours or every month.
steps: Loosen the nut, remove the pot cover, then pull out the air filter.
Remove the filter pot by loosening the No.10 nut.
Clean the filter with diesel, gently tap out the dirt, then dry it with a blower.
The filter pot can be cleaned with diesel or water mixed with detergent — dry it fully before reassembling.
Before assembling, fill TRA CHANG engine oil to the marked limit, then tighten the No.10 nut.
Reassemble the air filter and pot cover, then tighten the nut.

image.alt: Real air filter housing on the ZT Plus engine for periodic maintenance

points.title: 2. Fuel system
points.desc: Clean the fuel filter every 100 hours or every month; change it every 400 hours.
steps: Remove the nut holding the fuel filter assembly.
Turn the filter cup out, then use pliers to separate the fuel filter.
Clean the cup and filter by tapping or brushing, then dry with a blower.
If the filter is clogged or torn, replace it immediately.
Assemble the fuel filter into the cup — don't forget the O-ring on top.
Turn the filter cup back on firmly and tighten the No.10 nut to lock it in place.

image.alt: Real fuel filter assembly on the ZT Plus engine for periodic maintenance

points.title: 3. Engine oil
points.desc: For a new engine, change the oil after the first 50 hours; after that, every 100 hours.
steps: Remove the oil drain plug and let the oil drain out completely.
Clean the oil filter with diesel.
Refit the drain plug and tighten it firmly.
Fill with TRA CHANG engine oil, SAE40 API CF.
The oil level must sit between the upper and lower marks.

image.alt: Real oil drain point on the ZT Plus engine for periodic maintenance

points.title: 4. Cooling water system
points.desc: Drain and refill the radiator every 3 months if using rust-proof powder, or every month if not.
steps: Open the radiator cap to help the water drain faster.
Remove the drain plug, let the water drain completely, then tighten the plug.
Add 1 bag of rust-proof powder and fill with clean water.
Close the cap tightly.

image.alt: Real radiator on the ZT Plus engine for periodic maintenance

points.title: 5. Fan belt
points.desc: Check the belt before every use — a broken belt in operation will cause the engine to overheat.
steps: The correct tension is 10-15 mm of deflection.
If the belt is cracked or torn, replace it immediately.

image.alt: Real cooling fan belt on the ZT Plus engine for periodic maintenance

guideDoc.title: ZT Plus Diesel Engine Maintenance Steps

tiller.title: NC Power Tiller — 5 Key Maintenance Points

points.title: 1. Transmission (gear) oil
points.desc: For a new unit, change the oil after the first 50 hours; after that, every 500 hours.
steps: Use TRA CHANG gear oil, SAE90 API GL-4.
Check the level at the sight gauge — it should sit in the middle of the indicator.
Close the lid tightly to keep out dust and water.

image.alt: Real gear oil check point on the NC Plus X power tiller for periodic maintenance

points.title: 2. Steering lever
points.desc: Left-right steering lever free play should be about 1-2 mm.
steps: Loosen nuts No.12 and No.14, then rotate the adjuster to the correct free play and lock the nuts.
Lubricate the steering cable regularly to extend its service life.
After lubricating, turn the rubber cap back to close the hole.

image.alt: Real steering lever adjustment on the NC Plus X power tiller for periodic maintenance

points.title: 3. Clutch free play
points.desc: Main clutch lever free play should be about 15-20 mm.
steps: Loosen the two No.14 nuts on the clutch cable.
Turn the cable end adjuster to set the correct free play, then recheck.

image.alt: Real clutch free-play adjustment on the NC Plus X power tiller for periodic maintenance

video.title: Video — Clutch free play check (power tiller)

points.title: 4. Brake free play
points.desc: Brake free play between the spring and adjusting nut should be about 3-5 mm.
steps: Pull the clutch lever to the disengaged position.
Loosen the nut at the cable end, adjust to the correct free play, then lock the nut tight.
Lubricate the brake cable regularly to extend its service life; turn the rubber cap closed afterward.

image.alt: Real brake free-play adjustment on the NC Plus X power tiller for periodic maintenance

video.title: Video — Brake free play check (power tiller)

points.title: 5. Drive belt tension
points.desc: The correct drive belt tension is about 30-40 mm.
steps: Tighten the wing nut to pull the belt pulley until the belt reaches the correct tension.
If the belt is cracked or torn, replace it with a new one.

image.alt: Real drive belt tension adjustment on the NC Plus X power tiller for periodic maintenance

solutions.desc: For puddled, flooded paddy fields planted more than once a year. Use the NC Plus X Special with 880 mm or 980 mm cage wheels and the Gear Insert turning system for heavy-duty puddle work. Pair with a KUBOTA ZT Plus 14-15.5 HP engine for enough power in deep mud.

solutions.name: Dry Paddy Field
solutions.desc: For loamy or sandy soil that isn't puddled, including dry-season paddy, sugarcane, cassava, beans, and vegetable plots. The NC Plus X with 800 mm cage wheels is the right fit — lighter, more agile, and able to travel short distances on its cage wheels.

solutions.name: Cassava Field
solutions.desc: For upland cassava plots on loamy or sandy soil. The NC Plus X with 800 mm cage wheels is the right fit — light and agile enough to work between planting rows without damaging cassava mounds, and able to travel short distances on its cage wheels between fields.

solutions.name: Corn (Maize) Field
solutions.desc: For upland maize plots on loamy or sandy soil, similar in profile to cassava and dry-season paddy. The NC Plus X with 800 mm cage wheels handles row spacing and short-distance travel between fields well.

crops.note: This page now covers four field types from the marketing team's crop-solution videos: wet paddy, dry paddy, cassava, and corn — every one now has a demo video available.

activities.name: 1. KUBOTA Family Day (KFD)
activities.purpose: Bring the actual products to customers, explain their key benefits, and show that the dealer can provide advice, service, and spare parts.

target: Farmers using other brands of diesel engines or power tillers who may be ready to change products
Customers whose current engine or power tiller has been used for a long time and may need replacement
New customers in areas where the dealer would like to introduce KUBOTA products
activities.venue: Choose an easy-to-reach location such as a village square, community center, temple yard, or dealer area. Provide registration, product display, seating, parking, and shaded space for around 30–50 people.
basicActivities: Register customers, collect contact details, and record which product they are interested in
Display a KUBOTA Diesel Engine and a TRA CHANG Power Tiller so customers can see the real products
Explain key product benefits and how to choose the right product in a short and simple way
Introduce the dealer, contact channels, after-sales service, and spare parts support
Allow time for customers to ask questions and talk with the team
optionalActivities: Customer experience sharing: Invite a local product owner to share a short, real experience

schedule.whatToDo: If attendance is high, use separate registration points for target prospects and general customers. Flag interested customers for sales follow-up. Distribute souvenirs or Lucky Draw coupons if provided.
Welcome customers. Introduce the dealer, service center, spare parts support, and any event promotion.
Use the real KUBOTA Diesel Engine and TRA CHANG Power Tiller to explain key benefits, basic applications, and simple genuine-product checks.
If included, invite a local product owner to share a short real experience. The MC should guide the questions and keep the session on time.
Answer customer questions. Explain the selected installment plan or promotion. Small prizes may be prepared for the Q&A session.

activities.purpose: Let customers see the KUBOTA Diesel engine and TRA CHANG Power Tiller working in real field conditions, understand correct operation, and try the product before deciding to buy.
activities.minParticipants: At least 30 customers per event; around 30–50 people is recommended so everyone can see the demonstration and the team can supervise test drives properly.
target: Farmers looking for diesel engines or power tillers for demanding agricultural work
Customers who want to see real field performance before buying
Users of other brands who want to compare product performance
Customers who want to learn correct operation and select suitable implements
activities.venue: Choose an easy-to-reach agricultural field with enough space for demonstration and supervised test drives. Around 0.25–0.5 hectare is recommended, with clearly separated field, test-drive area, customer tent, parking, and machine access route.
basicActivities: Register and welcome customers, and explain key instructions before entering the demonstration area
Introduce the KUBOTA Diesel Engine, TRA CHANG Power Tiller, and implements used in the event
Demonstrate the products in a real paddy field using suitable implements
Explain product controls, correct operation, and key benefits during the demonstration
Let customers test drive one at a time in the designated area with close supervision
Summarize the demonstration and allow customers to ask questions
optionalActivities: Fuel consumption test: Compare with a competitor engine or power-tiller engine of similar power

Promotion or installment plan: Prepare clear conditions and assign a team member to explain them

schedule.whatToDo: Register customers and distribute souvenirs or Lucky Draw coupons if provided. Welcome customers under the tent with drinking water and cold towels.

Demonstrate the products in a real paddy field using a Moldboard Plow, 2-Disc Plow, Rolling Harrow, or Ride-on Disc Plow as appropriate.
Invite customers to test drive one at a time in real field conditions. Explain the controls and supervise each customer closely.
If included, compare with a competitor engine or power-tiller engine of similar power. Advice may be requested from the KUBOTA expert team.
Summarize what customers saw, announce test results if applicable, and answer customer questions.
If included, explain the promotion, run the Lucky Draw, and provide snack boxes and drinking water before closing the event.
